channel.title: Tabish Hassan's blog
channel.description: Hands-on tests of AI coding tools, local AI and software building.

item.title: Claude Code token usage, tested: a one-word fix cost 58,000 tokens, and a precise prompt saved only 2%
item.description: I gave Claude Code agents 4 tiny edits, 16 runs. A one-word typo fix used about 58,000 tokens, and a precise prompt saved only 2%. Numbers and advice.

item.title: Local LLM MacBook test: a long prompt more than doubled the RAM, from 8.4 GB to 17.7 GB
item.description: I ran Gemma 3 12B on a MacBook Pro with prompts up to 65k tokens. Peak memory went from 8.4 GB to 17.7 GB. Every number, and what it means for RAM.

item.title: I gave 4 AI coding agents one sentence each. They built 4 business apps that passed 792 checks, and the checks still missed a security leak
item.description: 4 AI coding agents each built a business app from one sentence. All passed 792 of 792 checks, but a review still found a security leak and template bugs.

item.title: I tested the idea behind Claude Code's new Code Mode. The AI read 11x fewer tokens and stopped miscounting
item.description: I tested the idea behind Claude Code's Code Mode with a local model: 3 tasks, 9 runs each way. Script mode read 11x fewer tokens and never miscounted.

item.title: I tested 3 anti AI slop design skills on the same page. Only one changed the design
item.description: One landing page, built 4 times by AI. Only Anthropic's Frontend Design skill avoided AI slop design: 0 of 10 slop signs, against 5 for the rest.

item.title: Why AI coding agents slow down in long sessions, and 5 prompt caching mistakes to avoid
item.description: AI coding agents resend the whole chat every turn. Prompt caching keeps them fast, but one changed timestamp breaks it. 5 mistakes to avoid, tested on a Mac.

item.title: How much does a small business website cost? (2026 prices)
item.description: A small business website costs from about $150 a year with a builder to $1,000–$5,000 with a freelancer. Real 2026 prices, hidden fees and 3 budgets.

item.title: How to add subtitles to a video on your Mac, offline, in 100 languages
item.description: Add subtitles to a video on an Apple silicon Mac with nothing uploaded: transcribe, translate into up to 100 languages and export SRT files for YouTube.
